name: flags-lab
description: Hand-authored fixture for the TypeScript type flags the shape tier used to refuse (docs/plans/generator-architecture.md phase E, mapping document 4.1/4.2/4.11): template literals and string mappings, bigint and its literals, `object`, `symbol` and `unique symbol`. Tracked in git, no npm install, so the goldens pin every case - and its negatives - under the live compiler; index.js is the run gate's runtime for the bigint claim.
